data.name: Atharva
data.gender_notes: Atharva is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Atharva is a name derived from the ancient Indian texts, the Atharvaveda. It is associated with the god Atharva, who is considered the deity of knowledge, wisdom, and prosperity. The name is believed to bring blessings of knowledge, intelligence, and understanding. The name Atharva carries the meaning “Knowledge, Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Atharva usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Atharva total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

vedic_reference.note: The name 'Atharva' is derived from the Atharva Veda, one of the oldest and most revered texts in Hinduism. It is dedicated to the deity Atharvan, who is considered the God of Knowledge and Wealth.

historical_references.reference: The Atharvaveda is one of the oldest texts in the Hindu tradition, likely dating back to around 1200 BCE. It is a collection of hymns and rituals, and is considered to be the fourth of the Vedas. The Atharvaveda is particularly known for its spells and incantations, which were used to protect against various forms of evil and misfortune.
